environment.description: Same Go stream processor deployed on ECS Fargate. The HTTP path is fronted by an ALB with an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL includes a custom rule group 'template-injection-guard' with priority 1 that inspects request body JSON fields using a regex pattern set matching Go template directives (patterns: '{{', '}}', '.Exec', 'call', 'slice', 'printf', 'html/template', 'os.', 'exec.') with action BLOCK and a 403 response. Additionally, the managed rule group AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet is attached at priority 2 in BLOCK mode, which covers Log4j/JNDI patterns and general expression injection vectors. The Kafka topic has a Schema Registry enforcement (Confluent Schema Registry with BACKWARD compatibility) requiring messages conform to an Avro schema where the 'template' field is constrained to an enum of 5 pre-approved template strings. Messages failing schema validation are sent to a DLQ and never reach the consumer.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL association
config.container_runtime: ECS Fargate, task role with minimal permissions
